# Zodiac Man

> Free AI mystical-object identifier and astrology village, built in memory of Brian Carter ("Zodiac Man"), a blind Lancashire astrologer who read the stars over CB radio.

## Pages

- [Home](https://zodiacman.netlify.app/): The Spooky Do Village — Brian's Mystical Identifier (photo → spiritual/astrology identification, free, no sign-in, unlimited), Spooky Roast (same upload flow, a warm roast instead), Ask Zodiac Man chat, Personal Reading (birthday → horoscope/numerology/moon context), Tarot draw / Crystal ball / Daily rune (free, client-side), a free Supabase account (kudos, activity feed, QR code, bio), and The Hamlet (a directory for astrology/tarot/crystal professionals).

## About

Part of the FeelFamous -Oid Ecosystem. Built by Chris P Taylor (Doc Strange).
The core tool — identification, roast, chat, and personal reading — is free for everyone, no sign-in required, unlimited.
Membership here is sold via Stripe, not Patreon (the one exception in the ecosystem): Founder Villager is £27/year or £4.95/month (Villager number, QR code, Kudos, founding badge — community/cosmetic, not a tool gate); Master (Hamlet) is £97/year early rate (hosted directory listing for astrology/tarot/crystal professionals, QR, Kudos-per-signup).
Contact: chris@chrisptee.co.uk
